name: Uliana Sirotina
tagline: Engineering Manager | People Leadership & Hiring | Engineering Culture
about: Engineering Manager focused on people leadership, hiring and engineering culture, with 10 years in software engineering. As frontend hiring manager at Uberall, hired 13 engineers across all teams and kept the squad at zero attrition through an acquisition and a reorganisation. At SoSafe, promoted to lead within 4 months and led 8 engineers over 2 years through two team rebuilds. Technical depth to talk architecture; focus on performance, growth and how teams work together.
